title: Parvalbumin cell ribosome profiling in adult enhanced plasticity paradigms reveals distinct molecular signatures compared to juvenile critical period plasticity
authors: Benacom D; Chataing C; Ribot J; Queguiner I; Prochiantz A; Di Nardo AA
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过核糖体谱分析比较幼年关键期与成年可塑性范式中PV细胞的翻译组差异，完全不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: The juvenile brain is shaped by critical periods (CPs) of plasticity regulated in part by parvalbumin (PV) interneurons. The “reopening” of CPs has been explored in brain disorders, yet it remains unclear whether adult enhanced plasticity recapitulates developmental mechanisms. We profiled visual cortex PV-specific ribosome-associated mRNAs at the CP peak and in two adult plasticity paradigms, chondroitinase ABC (ChABC) injection and extracellular OTX2 blockade. No shared translatomic signature emerged between the three conditions. Nonetheless, CP and ChABC-induced plasticity shared genes coding for synaptic components and extracellular matrix. Condition-specific pathways highlighted mechano-transduction and cytoskeletal remodeling for ChABC plasticity and DNA repair and heterochromatin for CP plasticity. These juvenile pathways were supported by elevated γH2AX, H3K9me3, and DAPI foci in PV cells uniquely during the CP. Thus, adult plasticity does not simply reinstate juvenile mechanisms, but instead may recruit partially overlapping, condition-specific molecular pathways revealing candidate targets for enhancing adult plasticity.
abstract_zh: 幼年大脑的塑造受到关键期（CPs）可塑性的影响，这一过程部分由小清蛋白（PV）中间神经元调控。在脑疾病研究中，关键期的“重新开启”已被探索，但成年期增强的可塑性是否重现发育机制仍不清楚。我们分析了视觉皮层PV特异性核糖体相关mRNA在关键期峰值及两种成年可塑性范式——软骨素酶ABC（ChABC）注射和细胞外OTX2阻断——中的表达谱。三种条件下未出现共享的翻译组特征。尽管如此，关键期和ChABC诱导的可塑性共享编码突触组分和细胞外基质的基因。条件特异性通路突出显示，ChABC可塑性涉及机械传导和细胞骨架重塑，而关键期可塑性涉及DNA修复和异染色质。这些幼年通路得到支持，因为在关键期PV细胞中γH2AX、H3K9me3和DAPI焦点显著升高。因此，成年可塑性并非简单恢复幼年机制，而是可能招募部分重叠、条件特异性的分子通路，揭示增强成年可塑性的候选靶点。
